added: packages/recovery (@sos-2/recovery): brownfield architecture recovery producing MULTIPLE COMPETING ArchitectureGraph hypotheses from an observed ImplementationModel whenever evidence is ambiguous (spec/architecture.md section 6 'Code-to-architecture recovery may produce multiple competing hypotheses' and section 15; docs/code-to-architecture.md 'Brownfield recovery must preserve multiple hypotheses when evidence is ambiguous'): ambiguity sources are kind ambiguity (config.kindAmbiguities + the documented DEFAULT_KIND_AMBIGUITIES heuristic vocabulary — one hypothesis retained PER candidate node kind) and grouped realization (DIRECT vs MERGED_REALIZATIONS readings of realizes refinements); the space is the cross product capped by maxHypotheses (minimum 2 — the cap bounds explosion and can never collapse ambiguity to a single architecture; truncation retained as a TRUNCATED_HYPOTHESIS_SPACE marker); every hypothesis is a real DRAFT ArchitectureGraphArtifact (recovery proposes, never activates) created through @sos-2/architecture over the caller-supplied exact SystemState revision, carries a typed HypothesisDerivation (model id, exact revision, strategy, full kind assignment also stamped into the creation provenance so distinct interpretations are always distinct artifacts, input digest, counts, unresolved endpoints), typed ambiguity/uncertainty markers (frozen vocabulary: KIND_AMBIGUITY, GROUPED_REALIZATION, MULTI_REALIZES, MIXED_KIND_GROUP, MERGE_ID_COLLISION, UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY_ENDPOINT, DUPLICATE_DEPENDENCY_PAIR, INTERNAL_DEPENDENCY, TRUNCATED_HYPOTHESIS_SPACE), DERIVED_FROM and OBSERVES spine trace links to the source ImplementationModel id with source-revision provenance, and its model_view (the exact model interpretation asserted); the W4 interface projection extends classification coverage by mapping observed interfaces to Interface pseudo-components with Provides/Consumes edges inside the model view so the merged spine classifier can classify declared Interface nodes and Provides edges

packages/recovery (@sos-2/recovery) comparison: compareWithDeclared/compareHypothesisWithDeclared delegate entirely to the merged W2 reconcile (@sos-2/conformance classifyDifferences over each hypothesis' model view vs the declared ArchitectureGraphArtifact), emitting typed reconciliation records { classification, subject, reason, link } — drift classified, never silently resolved — plus a derived verdict (CONFORMANT / DRIFT_DETECTED / AMBIGUOUS, precedence DRIFT_DETECTED > AMBIGUOUS > CONFORMANT) and one hypothesis-to-declared trace link per comparison through the frozen mapping CONFORMANT->COMPATIBLE_WITH, DRIFT_DETECTED->CONFLICTS_WITH, AMBIGUOUS->DERIVED_FROM

packages/recovery (@sos-2/recovery) report: generateReconciliationReport, a deterministic (byte-identical on re-run, no hidden clocks) human-readable reconciliation report structured exactly along docs/code-to-architecture.md — WHAT WE DECLARED / WHAT WE OBSERVED / WHAT DIFFERS (every finding with its reason AND the frozen per-class belief statement CLASSIFICATION_RATIONALE answering 'why the difference is believed to be detail, variation, refinement, intentional evolution, drift, unknown or contradiction') / RETAINED AMBIGUITY (recovery markers verbatim) / SUMMARY (zero-filled counts for all 7 frozen conformance classes, subjects requiring human adjudication); sectionsFromComparisons adapts hypothesis comparisons into report sections

packages/runtime-conformance (@sos-2/runtime-conformance): the RuntimeViewAdapter contract consuming @sos-2/telemetry RawObservations (W3 is merged, so the telemetry-shaped adapter types are consumed directly — no local interface was defined) and projecting them into a RuntimeView (validated GraphShape, per-subject tallies over all 6 truth states zero-filled, sighted nodes with direct/indirect distinction, unprojected observations retained with reasons); the built-in structuralRuntimeAdapter interprets subject_ref as node id with runtime.node_kind and runtime.edges attributes and implied target kinds; evaluation of declared executable invariants (the @sos-2/conformance invariant DSL — the W2 executable-invariant authority built over @sos-2/architecture graph shapes) at an EXACT SystemState revision under two frozen honesty disciplines: WITNESS discipline (FAIL requires a positively witnessed violation — absence of observation is never observation of absence; FORBIDDEN_DEPENDENCY/LAYERING failures are edge-presence, DATA_OWNERSHIP witnessed only for multi-ownership, REQUIRED_INTERFACE failures are absence-based and yield UNKNOWN) and COVERAGE discipline (PASS requires COMPLETE coverage of the invariant's declared subject universe; buckets SIGHTED/UNSUPPORTED/GAP/UNOBSERVED keep all truth states distinct and a gap is never read as zero or as absence-of-violation per spec/architecture-lock.md); typed conformance evidence records minted by @sos-2/evidence createEvidence (kind runtime-conformance, OBSERVATIONAL, method runtime-conformance:invariant-check, deterministic sos://Evidence/ ids) with truthful availability through the frozen verdict/availability table (PASS->SUCCESS, FAIL->FAILURE, UNKNOWN->{UNKNOWN,UNAVAILABLE,UNSUPPORTED,PARTIAL}) and the anti-conflation guards isRuntimeConformanceRecord/isRuntimeConformanceResult rejecting conflated records loudly; every record links OBSERVES to the exact SystemState id and VERIFIES to the declared ArchitectureGraph id with provenance carrying the architecture id+version, every implementation git-sha, every deployment revision, the adapter id, the invariant and observation-set content hashes and the evaluation instant

packages/recovery/W4.architecture-delta.json: this Architecture Delta record — DECLARED HERE because spec/** is outside W4's owned paths; the Architect may reconcile it into spec/contracts/deltas/ at merge time
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace authority: both packages import minters, envelopes, trace links, canonical serialization and the conformance classifier from @sos-2/semantic-spine; no second identity system, no duplicated envelope logic, no invented core identifiers (all ids are spine-minted or spine-validated)

the 7 conformance classes, the 6 evidence truth states, the 17 frozen trace link types and the 19 core artifact kinds are all imported from their merged authorities and NEVER redefined, extended or re-registered; classification is always delegated to the merged W0.5 classifier via W2 reconcile (recovery never reimplements classification logic — it only constructs model interpretations the classifier then classifies)

ambiguous evidence produces MULTIPLE retained hypotheses (never one): enforced by construction, by the maxHypotheses minimum of 2, by the isRecoveryResult guard and pinned by negative and property tests; hypothesis artifacts are asserted unique per run and two interpretations can never silently converge

drift is classified and never silently resolved: comparisons emit W2 reconciliation records and derived verdicts; every unresolved or ambiguous artifact of recovery is retained as a typed ambiguity marker instead of being dropped

runtime truth states are never conflated: PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN verdicts map to disjoint availability sets (VERDICT_AVAILABILITY) enforced by guards and pinned by negative tests; UNAVAILABLE telemetry is never interpreted as zero or as absence-of-violation (spec/architecture-lock.md forbidden shortcut); absence-based invariant failures yield UNKNOWN, never FAIL

evidence discipline: all runtime conformance evidence is minted by the merged W3 @sos-2/evidence createEvidence (kind Evidence, OBSERVATIONAL class, explicit method provenance, deterministic content-addressed ids); LLM producers cannot carry calibrated numeric confidence (W3 rule enforced at input validation); 'spine envelopes, kind Evidence' from the W4 brief is realized as spine identities + the Evidence kind through the W3 authority — no second evidence authority is created and no envelope-wrapped evidence variant is introduced

exact-revision discipline: every recovered hypothesis references the exact SystemState revision it projects and the exact ImplementationModel revision it derives from (source-revision provenance tokens, W2 convention); every runtime conformance record binds the exact SystemState revision (subject_revision token), the declared architecture id+version (validated loudly against system_state.content.architecture_ref in BOTH id and version) and carries every implementation git-sha and deployment revision in provenance; the reverse graph->SystemState reference is deliberately not required because a mutually content-addressed pair is an unconstructible hash fixed point (documented in evaluate.ts and the README)

no silent autonomy: recovery outputs are DRAFT hypotheses that never activate, promote or self-approve anything; runtime conformance emits evidence only — verdicts are informational summaries over classified findings, never authorization

no frozen contract in spec/contracts/ was modified and no schema was touched; spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths (packages/semantic-spine, packages/contracts, packages/mission, packages/value, packages/context, packages/authority, packages/system-state, packages/architecture, packages/conformance, packages/evidence, packages/telemetry, packages/provenance) are untouched; all W4 changes are additive under the two owned packages

determinism discipline: canonical serialization, sorted marker/enumeration order, content-addressed hypothesis and evidence ids, frozen verdict/availability and witness tables, and pinned fast-check seeds (424242) make every operation repeatable; the report generator is a pure function producing byte-identical output on re-run (pinned by tests); the full test suite is required to produce identical results on repeated runs
boundary_changes: new workspace packages @sos-2/recovery and @sos-2/runtime-conformance; runtime dependencies: recovery -> semantic-spine + system-state (types) + architecture + conformance; runtime-conformance -> semantic-spine + system-state + architecture + conformance + evidence + telemetry + provenance (test-only devDependencies add fast-check/vitest/typescript/@types/node per W0.5 convention)
